category.instructions: Classify this English operational ticket by the observed problem or requested action. Use explicit evidence.

criteria.BUG: Incorrect existing behavior, error, regression or functional failure.
criteria.CONTENT_CHANGE: Editorial text, copy, translation or visual content change.
criteria.SUPPORT: Help, guidance, explanation or usage instructions.
criteria.ACCESS: Authentication, login, credentials, permission or authorization problem.
criteria.OTHER: Information or note needing none of these actions.

priority.instructions: Assign ticket priority from explicit operational impact. Default INCIDENT to HIGH, BUG and ACCESS to MEDIUM, other categories to LOW unless evidence warrants more.

criteria.LOW: Feature, content, support or informational request without exceptional impact.
criteria.MEDIUM: Bug or access problem without blocking or severe impact.
criteria.HIGH: Incident; blocking bug or critical access/work/deployment problem.
criteria.CRITICAL: Data loss/corruption, security compromise, or production outage with broad user impact.

risk.instructions: Assign operational risk from explicit evidence, not speculation. Default incident to MEDIUM; ordinary bug, login and routine requests to LOW.

criteria.LOW: No explicit operational harm; routine bug, login or request.
criteria.MEDIUM: Incident, blocking regression or operational permission problem without proven severe harm.
criteria.HIGH: Actual production outage, data loss/corruption or security compromise.
